title: Verify OptiSweep parcel data message flow from Chat (tracking ID, dimensions, package type) into sorter induction
summary: Use this lightweight diagnostic to confirm the source-described parcel messaging sequence: parcels move from trailer-unloading belts to sorter induction, then Chat sends a first message containing tracking ID, dimensions, and package type; if that first message fails for an unknown inducted parcel, OptiSweep assigns default dimensions; then a second Chat message provides tracking ID, barcode data, dimensional data, and potential destination data. When the parcel is on the sorter, dimensional data and destination indication should be present.
when_to_use: Use when you need to interpret whether the parcel’s data association into sorter induction matches the source-described Chat message flow (first message fields, default-dimensions behavior on failure, then second message fields) and to map what data should exist when a parcel is on the sorter.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for deeper database/message-flow troubleshooting beyond the source-described Chat message field expectations.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Verify that the observed parcel state/data fields align with the expected first and second Chat message contents and the on-sorter expected presence of dimensional data and destination indication.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the system surface that shows Chat messages and their payload fields (tracking ID, dimensions, package type; then barcode data, dimensional data, potential destination data) as referenced by the source

steps.title: If the first Chat message fails, confirm unknown inducted parcels use OptiSweep default dimensions
steps.purpose: Interpret the expected fallback behavior when the first Chat message fails for an unknown inducted parcel.
steps.instruction: If the first Chat message fails and the parcel is treated as unknown inducted, confirm that OptiSweep assigns default dimensions to that parcel.
steps.expected_result: For an unknown inducted parcel with a failed first message, the parcel is associated with default dimensions by OptiSweep.
steps.healthy_condition: Default dimensions are present/used for the unknown inducted parcel when the first message fails.
steps.failure_condition: Unknown inducted parcels do not receive default dimensions when the first Chat message fails (or default dimensions are not observable/used).

actions.label: Verify default-dimensions fallback on first-message failure
actions.exact_action: If this message fails and we see something unknown inducted, it is assigned default dimensions by OptiSweep.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you observe a first-message failure but the parcel is not associated to default dimensions for an unknown inducted parcel, treat it as a messaging/data-association issue and escalate for deeper investigation.

steps.purpose: Confirm the on-sorter expected state derived from the two-message Chat sequence.
